data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for the United Kingdom summarises system characteristics and outcomes using the latest available published indicators. It highlights educational inequalities in tertiary attainment by parents’ education, labour-market differences by attainment level, and trends in tertiary participation and completion. It also reports adult literacy proficiency patterns using the OECD Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), including shares at low proficiency and changes between Survey of Adult Skills Cycle 1 (2012–15) and Cycle 2 (2023). The note further describes education financing and resource allocation (tuition fees, student loans, expenditure per student) and selected teacher and school-system indicators. Because it is not an original student-level modeling study, it does not specify microdata sampling, plausible-value procedures, missing-data handling, or ML model evaluation; the figures are presented as descriptive benchmarks from OECD indicator tables.
